description: This file defines functions and classes related to creating and managing test reporters in the Playwright test framework. It includes logic for loading reporters, creating reporter instances for test runs and test servers, and handling reporter errors.

classes.name: ErrorCollectingReporter
classes.description: A reporter that collects errors during test execution and outputs them via a screen object.

methods.name: createReporters
methods.description: Creates an array of reporter instances based on configuration, mode, and environment.

methods.name: createReporterForTestServer
methods.description: Creates a reporter instance for a test server, with message sink integration.

methods.name: createErrorCollectingReporter
methods.description: Creates a reporter that collects errors and writes formatted error messages to stderr.
